headline: Entegris tops guidance as margins expand on chip demand
summary_short: Entegris' Q2 FY2026 net sales rose 11.5% y/y to $883.2M, GAAP diluted EPS climbed 74.3% y/y to $0.61, and gross margin expanded to 47.6% from 44.4% as growth accelerated across both segments and the company guided Q3 revenue to $905M-$935M.
summary_long: Q2 FY2026 net sales rose 11.5% y/y (8.8% q/q) to $883.2M, led by Advanced Purity Solutions (+17.0% y/y to $514.6M) outpacing Materials Solutions (+4.6% y/y to $371.3M). GAAP gross margin expanded to 47.6% from 44.4% y/y; adjusted operating margin rose to 24.5% from 20.9%. Net income more than doubled to $93.6M ($0.61 diluted EPS; $0.93 non-GAAP). Entegris repaid $200M of debt in the quarter, cutting long-term debt to $3,456.0M, while cash fell to $353.6M on the paydown and $15.4M of dividends, partly offset by $18.2M of stock issuance. The company guided Q3 2026 sales of $905M-$935M and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.96-$1.04, citing continued semiconductor demand growth.
